purpose: Teach: ディベート/主体性/スパン/税額/キャスティング/特技/創意/突出

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 採用面接、本気で、絶対、ディベート、絶対、課題を、絶対、入れてみましょう
lines.en: For the hiring interviews, let's make sure we add a debate component. I really want to see how candidates think on their feet.
lines.style: Purposeful and organized. Crisp delivery with slight forward momentum. Confident in the suggestion without being presumptuous. Lands on the key point—the debate task—with clarity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。候補者の主体性、本気で、絶対、見極めたいですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, exactly. We'll be able to see their initiative that way. It's a good test of who they really are.
lines.style: Warm agreement, leaning in slightly. The tone of someone affirming a colleague's instinct without needing to elaborate. Genuine endorsement with a trace of shared understanding.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: プロジェクトのスパン、本気で、絶対、半年で、絶対、設定しましょうか
lines.en: Should we set the project timeline at six months? That feels about right for something like this.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost checking herself. Medium pace with a gentle upward lilt at the question. Open to input but already forming a view. The cadence of someone used to collaborative planning.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の税額、本気で、絶対、本年、絶対、増加、絶対、見込みです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, and I wanted to mention—we're projecting a significant increase in tax obligations this year. It's important to factor that in.
lines.style: Steady, informative tone. Delivers the business update clearly without dramatics. A slight pause before the key number to let it land. Professional but not distant.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: CMの、本気で、絶対、キャスティング、絶対、若手に、絶対、お願いしましょう
lines.en: For the commercial casting, let's reach out to some younger talent. I think they'd bring the right energy to this.
lines.style: Directional but not dictatorial. Measured pace with clear intention. The 'let's' lands with collaborative warmth. Ends on a note of quiet conviction about the choice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、本気で、絶対、特技、絶対、活かせる場、絶対、設けております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We've already set up opportunities for staff to use their unique skills. We're committed to getting the best out of everyone.
lines.style: Confident, measured delivery. The tone of someone reporting good news they can stand behind. Slight emphasis on 'already' and 'committed' to show initiative. Warm professionalism.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新事業、本気で、絶対、創意あふれる、絶対、提案、絶対、集めましょう
lines.en: For the new business unit, let's collect proposals with real creative vision. We need bold ideas, not safe ones.
lines.style: Energized but controlled. Clear directives delivered with underlying optimism. The 'bold' lands with emphasis. Ends on a note of expectation—you're lifting the bar together.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、業界で、絶対、突出した、絶対、地位、絶対、保ってまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, and I want you to know we'll keep defending that position in the industry. We've earned our standing, and we'll maintain it.
lines.style: Steady closing statement with quiet confidence. Formal but not cold. A sense of responsibility in the voice—this is a pledge, not just a report. Lands with measured gravity.
